purpose: Faithful spatial CBS baseline for AIC revision — reviewer request for a stronger conflict-based comparison
cbs_variant: standard CBS (Sharon et al. 2012) adapted to permanent spatial vertex occupancy
conflict_definition: shared interior voxel (path[1:-1]) — not temporal; endpoints excluded because foreign terminals are already forbidden in low-level A*
low_level_solver: A* with Manhattan heuristic; direction-state to price bends/vertical; congestion_weight=0.0 (CBS constraints handle conflicts explicitly)
branching: for each conflict voxel v shared by agents i and j: branch by adding v to constraints[i] OR constraints[v]; deduplicate by constraint signature

termination.on_timeout: record success=0, routed=0, status=timeout; no partial result claimed

success_definition: all commodities routed with zero remaining conflicts (validate_paths passes)
validation: routing_revision_solvers.validate_paths — checks endpoints, six-connectivity, no blocked voxels, no shared voxels, drainage non-ascending
primary_comparison: CBS vs pbs_random on same 150 scenes (same generator, same seeds)
statistical_tests: paired bootstrap CI on physical cost (jointly-completed subset, seed 20261104, 10000 resamples)
reporting_rule: adverse/null results must be reported; do not selectively report densities

pilot.purpose: feasibility and code correctness only, not hypothesis testing

note: CBS is all-or-nothing; pbs_random can partially succeed. This structural difference must be stated in the manuscript.
